answer.what_it_does: Ideaforge Technology Ltd develops and manufactures uncrewed aerial systems (UAVs) and drones. It provides resilient, high-performing drones and related software, analytics, and services for defense, civil, and enterprise applications.

segments.name: Defense
segments.note: Defense sector UAV sales and solutions

segments.name: Civil
segments.note: Civil and enterprise sector UAV sales and solutions

answer.customers: Defense, civil, and enterprise customers including military and police forces.

facts.fact: As of June 30, 2026, ideaForge had an intellectual property portfolio of 112 patents (61 granted and 51 pending).
As of March 31, 2026, ideaForge had a workforce of 536 employees.

answer.geography: Primarily India, with emerging international expansion including the US and Japan.
answer.revenue_mix_basis: Share of revenue by customer category for FY 2025-26

risks.risk: Technology Risk or inability to adapt to evolving technology could compromise intellectual property and competitiveness.
Breach or leakage of sensitive data could damage reputation, client trust, and regulatory compliance.
Dependence on vendors and third-party suppliers for components or services could disrupt production or impact service quality.
Non-compliance with laws, ISO standards, or Indian regulatory frameworks could lead to legal or financial penalties.
